title: Distance, minimising curves and completeness
summary: The distance function and the metric-space structure of a Riemannian manifold (Proposition 5.10, proved); Gauss's lemma and the minimising property of short geodesics; totally geodesic submanifolds (Definition 7.24); completeness and the Hopf–Rinow theorem, with Theorem 7.34 (complete manifolds have geodesics between any two points) and symmetric spaces as examples.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is Gudmundsson Proposition 5.10 and chapter 7 (Theorem 7.23, Definition 7.24, Proposition 7.33, Theorem 7.34) with Sternberg §6.5–6.6 (Gauss's lemma, minimisation of arc length) and Lee chapter 6 as the commercial reference.

preparation.description: Re-read Gudmundsson Proposition 5.10 (p. 64), whose proof the notes defer; this unit supplies it.
Read Gudmundsson pp. 102–105: Theorem 7.23, Definition 7.24 and Proposition 7.25 (totally geodesic submanifolds), Definition 7.31 (symmetric spaces), Proposition 7.33 and Theorem 7.34.
Read Sternberg §6.5 (Gauss' lemma) and §6.6 (minimization of arc length) for the open-licensed proof of the local minimising property.
